import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

def kabsch(P, Q):
    # proper rotation mapping P onto Q (both Nx3, centered)
    H = P.T @ Q
    U,S,Vt = np.linalg.svd(H)
    d = np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T @ U.T))
    D = np.diag([1,1,d])
    R = Vt.T @ D @ U.T
    return R

# 2D pixel targets for 6-ring (x right, y up), scale 30 px/A
px = {1:(155,88), 2:(155,133), 3:(198,152), 4:(245,133), 10:(245,88), 11:(198,63)}
tgt = np.array([[px[i][0]/30.0, -px[i][1]/30.0, 0.0] for i in (1,2,3,4,10,11)])
tgt -= tgt.mean(axis=0)

results = {}
for tag, smi in [('cisA',"BrC1=C[CH+][C@@H]2N(C)C(=O)C[C@@H]2C1"),
                 ('cisB',"BrC1=C[CH+][C@H]2N(C)C(=O)C[C@H]2C1")]:
    m = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi); m = Chem.AddHs(m)
    AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m, randomSeed=11); AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m)
    P = m.GetConformer().GetPositions()
    src = P[[1,2,3,4,10,11]]; src = src - src.mean(axis=0)
    R = kabsch(src, tgt)
    Pall = (P - src.mean(axis=0)) @ R.T
    # H on fusion carbons 4 and 10
    Hs = {}
    for idx in (4,10):
        for nb in m.GetAtomWithIdx(idx).GetNeighbors():
            if nb.GetSymbol()=='H': Hs[idx]=nb.GetIdx()
    z4 = Pall[Hs[4]][2]; z10 = Pall[Hs[10]][2]
    print(tag, 'zH(Cd)=%.2f zH(Cc)=%.2f'%(z4,z10), 'cis' if np.sign(z4)==np.sign(z10) else 'trans')
    results[tag] = (m, Pall, Hs)
